title: Temporal dependency test with q1-only information withheld from the reset arm
question: Does preserving q1-time information across the action boundary improve q2 when the q2 target depends on information that is unavailable after the boundary?
hypothesis: A carry-enabled PLM will solve the registered temporal-dependency task better than a fresh post-boundary state that receives only q2-time observations.

interventions.carry: retain the pre-q1 state and traverse the q1 boundary normally
interventions.fresh_post_boundary: discard all q1-time state and initialize a fresh state from q2-time observations only

integrity_gates: same post-boundary q2 observation across arms
fresh arm receives no q1-time state, action, outcome, or verifier signal
q1 outcome is generated only from independent bits 0 and 1
q2 target is independent of the fresh arm's masked secret surface
evaluation secret/visible combinations are exactly balanced

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass; carry-minus-fresh q2 >= 0.10; paired hierarchical bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that preserving q1-time information improves q2 on the registered temporal-dependency task
decision_rule.does_not_license: general long-horizon memory, semantic memory, learned addressing, operator discovery, scaling, or real-world multimodal competence

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass but the materiality or lower-bound criterion fails
decision_rule.licenses: the registered task does not demonstrate a load-bearing q1-to-q2 carry benefit
decision_rule.does_not_license: memory impossibility or general PLM failure

decision_rule.condition: any information-flow or leakage gate fails
decision_rule.does_not_license: any architectural inference from the run

claim_boundary: does not establish general long-horizon memory
does not establish learned addressing or operator discovery

arms.name: carry
arms.intervention: retain q1-time state and traverse the action boundary

arms.name: fresh_post_boundary
arms.intervention: discard all q1-time state and initialize only from q2-time observations

interpretation_order: same q2 query and post-boundary observation
q1/q2 dependency construction and exact evaluation balance
paired q2 difference and hierarchical uncertainty interval
